reason: S1 introduces a new stateful progressive-encoding protocol that H0 cannot exercise. The protocol starts with spng_encode_image(..., flags containing SPNG_ENCODE_PROGRESSIVE), which initializes encoding and returns early, and then requires input through the new public entry points spng_encode_scanline() or spng_encode_row(). H0 only constructs a decode context, supplies PNG input through spng_set_png_file(), spng_set_png_stream(), or spng_set_png_buffer(), and invokes decode/getter APIs. Thus it provides neither the encoding setup/state nor scanline/row input needed to reach the new behavior. Although lack of ordinary encoding coverage may predate the commit, the progressive flag and two progressive entry points are introduced by S1, so this material gap is commit-induced.
evidence: spng/spng.h adds SPNG_ENCODE_PROGRESSIVE and declares spng_encode_scanline() and spng_encode_row().
spng_encode_image() newly returns immediately when flags & SPNG_ENCODE_PROGRESSIVE after setting ctx->state = SPNG_STATE_FIRST_IDAT, establishing a multi-call state protocol.
spng_encode_scanline() and spng_encode_row() accept distinct caller-controlled buffers and lengths and advance encoding through encode_scanline() or encode_row().
tests/spng_read_fuzzer.c calls spng_decoded_image_size(), spng_decode_image(), and spng_decode_row(), but never calls spng_encode_image(), spng_encode_scanline(), or spng_encode_row().
recommended_action: Extend or add a harness mode that creates and configures an encoding context and IHDR, calls spng_encode_image() with SPNG_ENCODE_PROGRESSIVE, then fuzzes sequences of spng_encode_scanline() and spng_encode_row() calls with controlled buffers, lengths, and call counts, including undersized lengths and calls at or after SPNG_STATE_EOI.
